packageRules.description: pnpm 12 refuses a lockfile entry published less than a day ago (minimumReleaseAge, 1440 min by default), so an npm update opens only once it is a day old: a younger one fails `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (#21).
@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers peers vitest ^4.1 (0.22.0), so a vitest major waits until the pool supports it: approve it from the Dependency Dashboard.

muda is a dev-dependency only so the menu test parses shortcuts with the parser tauri links (src-tauri/src/menu.rs, #93). It stays on tauri's muda and moves by hand when a tauri update moves it, never on its own.
